summary: One choice of a radio group.

value.description: What the group's value becomes when this radio is chosen.

checked.description: This is the chosen radio. The group keeps at most one; a script that sets it chooses the radio.

disabled.description: It cannot be changed or focused.

root.note: Holds the author's label text and draws no face and no focus ring of its own. In a segmented group it is the segment: no face at rest, its ink taken from the group; while checked it is the anchor of the group's thumb, which is its raised face (C32), and paints none of its own; there it draws the focus ring, inside itself.

well.note: Round, the full icon size of ui-geometry (a.full, one q more than a.md). Keyboard focus draws the ring round it. Not drawn in a segmented group, where ::before has no paint and is the segment's hit area over the track's padding.

bead.note: Shown while checked: the radio-dot row, half the a.md glyph of the well's icon box, centred. Not generated in a segmented group.

keys.Space: Chooses the radio at key up.

notYet: A disabled radio still dispatches click to a listener the author adds; the group ignores it.
